text:
lena: Hi all, quick onboarding question. I merged the kubeconfig from `aws eks update-kubeconfig` but `kubectl get pods -n lena-dev` says Forbidden. I can `kubectl config get-contexts` and see a context named `arn:aws:eks:us-west-2:123456789012:cluster/redwood-dev` but the role ARN in the user exec looks like a role I don't have. Any tips?

axel: welcome! most likely you're missing the RoleBinding in your namespace. New hires get a namespaced role (`onboard-edit`) by default. File the access form or ping infra.

lena: where's the form? I couldn't find it in the handbook.

chen: https://redwood.example.com/access -> choose "Kubernetes namespace access". Put `namespace=lena-dev` and request `onboard-edit`. In the meantime, try `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n lena-dev` to verify.

lena: `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n lena-dev` -> no. Filed the form.

infra-bot: access request created for lena at 1976550002, id #K-10543. Assigned to infra oncall. ETA ~1h.

axel: small tip: after infra approves, re-run `aws sso login --profile redwood-onboard` so your SSO session picks up the role mapping. Then `kubectl config use-context <that-arn-context>` and `kubectl get pods -n lena-dev` should work.

lena: infra approved, re-ran `aws sso login` and now `kubectl get pods -n lena-dev` works. Posting the tiny alias I added: `alias kctx="kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=lena-dev"` in case it helps other new hires. Thanks!
